insights.one_liner: Nearfield Instruments is a Rotterdam chip-tech scale-up building metrology machines for top chipmakers, backed by new investment and a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: It calls itself a fast-growing high-tech scale-up that designs, builds and services advanced metrology machines.
Its machines help the world's leading chipmakers raise production yields of microchips.

open.text: Nearfield Instruments B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an internship in Rotterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Dutch pension fund ABP made a co-investment in Nearfield Instruments.
Qatar's sovereign fund QIA counts Nearfield among its three deep-tech bets.
